title: Design token rules
description: Rules for raw values, token naming, themes and required contrast pairs.

rules.title: Raw colour literal outside token definition files
rules.message: A raw colour literal is used outside the token definition files.
rules.fix: Reference a semantic token with var(--color-...) and define the value once in the token files.
rules.rationale: Scattered literals drift apart and cannot follow a theme.

rules.title: Raw spacing or radius length not in the token scale
rules.message: A raw spacing or radius length is used instead of a scale token.
rules.fix: Use a spacing or radius token such as var(--space-3).
rules.rationale: Arbitrary lengths make spacing inconsistent and hard to change.

rules.title: Custom property is not lowercase kebab-case
rules.message: A custom property name is not lowercase kebab-case.
rules.rationale: A single naming grammar keeps tokens searchable and mappable across tools.

rules.title: Semantic token named by colour or position
rules.message: A token is named after its colour or position instead of its role.
rules.rationale: Role names survive a rebrand or a dark theme; colour names do not.

rules.title: var() reference to an undefined custom property without fallback
rules.message: var() references a custom property that nothing defines, and it has no fallback.
rules.fix: Define the token, fix the name, or add a fallback value.
rules.rationale: An undefined property makes the declaration invalid at computed-value time.

rules.title: Token defined but never used
rules.message: A token is defined in the token files but nothing references it.
rules.rationale: Dead tokens hide the real vocabulary of the design system.

rules.title: Token present in one theme block and missing in another
rules.message: A token exists in one [data-theme] block but not in another.
rules.fix: Define the token in every theme.
rules.rationale: A missing token silently falls back to another value and breaks contrast.

rules.title: Required contrast pair fails
rules.message: A required foreground and background token pair is below the contrast minimum.
rules.fix: Choose colours from the palette solver or adjust the pair; never relax the threshold.
rules.rationale: Contrast is arithmetic: the pair either meets the target or it does not.
